facts.fact: ITWeb reports that South Africa's Information Regulator received breach notifications, including from SA Home Loans after its 13 November 2026 intrusion, and reported over 8,000 security compromise incidents by August 2026.
ITWeb reports the Information Regulator counted more than 8,000 security compromise incidents by August 2026, and that SA Home Loans notified it of its November 2026 breach.
